skills.name: Record Layout Shifts via Performance Observer
skills.description: Capture and log Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) events programmatically by pasting a Performance Observer script into the browser console. Provides a console-based alternative to DevTools Performance Panel for detecting, analyzing, and attributing layout shifts during page inter...
skills.skill_body:
Use this skill when you need to programmatically capture layout shift data without relying on the DevTools Performance Panel. Paste a Performance Observer script into the browser console while browsing the target page. The observer will record layout shift events with timing and attribution details, outputting results to the console log. This approach is useful for automating CLS detection in custom test scripts or when DevTools is not available.

## Objective

Programmatic CLS event capture and analysis via console-based Performance Observer
## Applicable Signals

- Need to capture layout shift data without DevTools
- Automating CLS detection in custom test scripts
- Debugging layout shifts during page interaction
- Collecting CLS attribution information programmatically

## Contraindications

- DevTools Performance Panel is sufficient for one-off analysis
- Measuring CLS at scale in production (use RUM libraries instead)
- Real-time visual monitoring of layout shifts is the primary need

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Open the browser console on the target web page'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Paste a Performance Observer script configured to observe layout-shift entries'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Interact with the page or allow it to load fully'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Review console output for recorded layout shift events with timing and attribution data'}

## Constraints

- Requires browser console access
- Script must be pasted into console while page is loaded or during interaction
- Output is limited to console log; not suitable for persistent data collection without additional logging infrastructure

## Cautions

- Console output may be cleared or lost if page reloads
- Performance Observer API support varies by browser; verify browser compatibility
- For production-scale CLS collection, use dedicated RUM providers or the web-vitals library instead

## Output Contract

- Console output or log containing recorded layout shift events, including timing information and attribution data for each shift. Output is available in the browser console and can be copied or exported for analysis.

skills.name: Collect Field CLS Attribution Data
skills.description: Instrument production applications with web-vitals library attribution functions or equivalent RUM provider APIs to gather detailed Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) metrics from real user sessions, including element identifiers, shift timing, and user context for pattern analysis.
skills.skill_body:
Instrument your production application with the web-vitals library's attribution functions or equivalent RUM provider APIs to collect CLS metrics from real user sessions. Capture element identifiers, shift timing, and user context. Aggregate and analyze the collected data to identify patterns in layout shift causes and frequency across your user base.

## Objective

Production CLS data collection and attribution
## Applicable Signals

- Production traffic available for instrumentation
- RUM infrastructure or web-vitals library integration possible
- Need for attribution-level CLS insights beyond lab measurements

## Contraindications

- Performing lab-based diagnosis using DevTools or Lighthouse
- Testing in development or staging environments without production traffic
- RUM infrastructure not available or not deployable
- Privacy constraints preventing collection of user interaction data

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Integrate web-vitals library or RUM provider with attribution support into production application'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Configure attribution functions to capture element identifiers and timing information for each layout shift'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Collect CLS metrics along with user context (session ID, user segment, page type) from production sessions'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Aggregate collected data in your analytics or monitoring backend'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Analyze patterns to identify which elements and scenarios cause the most significant layout shifts'}

## Constraints

- Requires web-vitals library or compatible RUM provider with attribution support
- Must have production deployment capability
- Data collection must comply with privacy and consent policies
- Attribution data collection adds minimal overhead to user sessions

## Cautions

- Ensure user consent and privacy compliance before collecting field data
- Monitor instrumentation overhead to avoid impacting page performance
- Aggregate data appropriately to protect individual user privacy

## Output Contract

- Collected field CLS metrics with attribution data including element identifiers, shift timing, and user context aggregated from production sessions; ready for analysis and correlation with user behavior patterns
